tei:div.tei:p: 355) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: yi dam dbang chen yab yum gyi rtsa dbang byin rlabs gter mdzod bzhugs: 356) na mo padma kro dha ye: (Dakini secret letter here) rang rig sku gsum mkha' 'gror 'dud: gsang sngags lam zhugs rnal 'byor pa: skal ldan las can smin pa'i thabs: byin rlabs dbang gi chu bo bstan: las 'phro ldan pa'i dpal du shog: sa ma ya: dben zhing yid 'ong skyon bral dang: byin chags gnas su sta gon gyi: rdzas sogs ji bzhin tshad ldan bkod: lta spyod ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis: snod ldan smin grol la 'god phyir: bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom pa dang: yid ches phyir du lo rgyus brjod: yon phul gsol ba btab pa ni: kyai: bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa che: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: theg pa mchog gi gsang ba'i lam: smin byed dbang bskur bstsal du gsol: lan gsum bzlas: de nas bla mas gnang ba sbyin pa ni: e ma e ma rigs kyi bu: khyed cag skal ldan las 'phro can: gsang sngags dkyil 'khor 'di la spro: bdag gis bsgo ba'i bka' bzhin mdzod: dbang rnams ma lus bdag gis bstsal: spro ba bskyed la dad gus mdzod: snod mi ldan rnams phyir dengs shig: rdo rje'i dam gyis tshig par 'gyur: de phyir snod ldan skyes 357)bu la: smin byed mchog 'di bdag gis bgyi: de nas skyabs 'gro 'bogs pa ni: na mo: rang rig bde chen 'gyur ba med: byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor che: dbang chen yab yum lha tshogs la: 'du 'bral med par skyabs su mchi: lan gsum dang: sems bskyed ni: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bdag cag skal ldan las can la: thun mong dang ni thun min gyi: bslab gsum bdag la gnang du gsol: khyed kyis bsgo ba'i bka' bzhin du: srog gi phyir yang dam mi 'gal: cho ga bzhin du bdag gis bsgrub: lan gsum dang: de nas bla mas dam tshig bsgrags pa ni: hoḥ

'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: khyed cag ngag tu blud pa yis: bsrung na tshe 'dir dngos grub thob: nyams na rdo rje'i mes tshig 'gyur: de bas dam tshig ji bzhin srungs: badzra sa ma ya na ra kan: zhes dam chu sbyin: de nas mig ras sbyin pa ni: 358) ma rig pa'i ling tog bsal ba'i phyir du dar yug dmar po res gdong bcings ba'i mos pa mdzod: oṃ tsakṣu bhandha wa ra ma ṇa ye swā hā: me tog sbyin pa ni: khyed rang rnams kyis lhag pa'i lha dang mjal ba'i phyir phyag stong par mjal du mi rung bas phyag rten gyi slad du me tog u dum wa ra'i me tog re 'dzin pa'i mos pa mdzod: a khaṃ wi ra hūm̐: de nas slob ma lhar bskyed cing ye shes bskyed bstim rim pa ni: oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā= sogs nas: haṃḥ stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bdag mdun ye shes kyi thugs rje byin rlabs ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu las slob ma'i ma dag pa'i sgrib gnyis bag chags gdos bcas sha khrag gi phung po dang bcas pa chos dbyings spros pa dang bral ba'i dbyings su 'ja' tshon nam mkha' la yal ba ltar song bar bsam: slar skad cig gis rig pa'i ngo bo hrīḥyig dmar gsal yongs su gyur pa las: slob ma dpal chen padma he ru kaḥ sku mdog dmar= sogs nas spyan 'dren yan gzhung du 'jug: ye shes pa bstim: me tog phul ba ni: kyai: rig pa'i me tog dam pa 'di: dkyil 'khor lha la gus pas 'bul: sngon gyi yi dam gang yin 359)pa'i: lhag lha mchog der 'bab par mdzod: badzra puṣpe siddhi trām̐: de nas lhag lha bstan pa ni: rdo rje slob dpon gyis 'di skad do: 'o: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyed rang rnams kyis rig pa'i me tog phul ba tshe sngon gyi 'brel ba'i lhag pa'i lha la babs pa yin pas ming gi cod pan ma brjed par yid la zungs shig: shar du babs na badzra bidyā: lho ru babs na ratna don grub: nub tu babs na padma dbang phyug:

byang du babs na karma rang grol: dbus su babs na buddha kīrti: zhes ming gi cod pan dang: lhag pa'i lha yang de'i rigs kyi sgrub pa la gzhol na dngos grub kyang myur du thob par nges so: mtshams su babs na dngos grub phran bu re thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa yin par ma brjed par yid la zungs shig: de nas mig dar bsal ba ni: hoḥ bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa yis: ye shes gser gyi thur ma 'dis: khyod kyi ma rig sgrib pa bsal: ye shes spyan du thob par shog: badzra tsa kṣu pra be sha ya phaṭa: de nas dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni: e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu: rang byung rig pa byang chub 360)sems: dkyil 'khor kun gyi 'byung gnas che: snang ba yangs pa chos kyi mkhar: rig stong yongs grub bkod pa ngoms: sna tshogs dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub: skal ldan khyed la mthong ba bstan: 'di don mngon gyur gding thob mdzod: rang rig las gzhan yod ma yin: rgyun du 'bral med ngo shes mdzod: bhrūm̐ dzñā na pra ti hoḥ de nas dngos gzhi'i lha dbang zhu ba'i phyir maṇḍal phul: de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bdag cag skal ldan slob bu la: padma dbang chen dngos gzhi'i dbang ཿ yongs rdzogs bdag la gnang du gsol: zhes lan gsum dang: slob dpon gyis: e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu: khyed cag las dang skal bar ldan: bla med dkyil 'khor 'di la dad: ngas bsgos bka' bzhin ma 'da' srungs: dngos grub rnam gnyis de las 'byung: de phyir dam tshig ma 'da' bar: gsang ba ji bzhin nyams su longs: badzra sa ma ya na ra kan: de nas bum pa thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ bsam brjod bral ba'i bum pa ru: ye shes bdud rtsis chu yis bkang: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: sku dbang yongs su rdzogs thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa 361)oṃ: de nas gtso bo'i sku thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ thabs mchog mi 'gyur padma gar gyi dbang ཿ

stong nyid shes rab rdo rje phag mo 'khril: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed pa mthar phyin sprul sku'i sa thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi= de nas badzra hya grī wa'i sku thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ me long ye shes rang bzhin 'dzin pa bral: dga' ba'i rang gzugs badzra hya grī: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: zhe sdang rang grol mchog gi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya= de nas ratna hya grī wa'i sku thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ mnyam nyid ye shes rang bzhin sgrib pa med: mchog dga'i rang gzugs ratna hya grī: skal ldan= nga rgyal rang grol= rtsa sngags: kā ya= de nas padma hya grī wa'i sku thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ sor rtogs rang gdangs ye shes gar bsgyur ba: khyad dga'i rang gzugs padma hya grīḥ skal ldan= 'dod chags rang= rtsa sngags: kā ya= de nas karma hya grī wa'i sku thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ bya grub rang gdangs ye shes gar bsgyur ba: lhan skyes dga' ba'i rang gzugs he ru kas: skal ldan= phrag dog rang= rtsa sngags= kā ya= de nas buddha hya grī wa'i sku thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ 362)chos dbyings rang gdangs ye shes gar bsgyur ba: dga' bral ye shes mchog gi rang gzugs gar: buddha hya grī was dbang bskur ro: gti mug rang grol chos kyi sku 'thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya= de nas khro bo bcu'i sku thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ phyin bcu gnas dag ye shes gar bsgyur ba: bgegs 'dul khro bo bcu yis dbang bskur ro: dge bcu mthar phyin mchog gi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya= de nas sgo ba yab yum gyi sku thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ tshad med rang gzugs ye shes mchog gi gar: rtag chad mu bzhi mthar phyin sgo skyong gis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: 'gro kun yongs su sgrol ba'i dbang thob shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ kā ya= bhandha'i bdud rtsi thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ bde chen chos dbyings bhandha ru:

rang gsal sngags kyi bdud rtsis bkang: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: brjod bral sngags kyi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: wakka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas rig tsaka thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ bcu drug dga' ster lang tsho ldan: bde stong ye shes spel ba'i ma: skal ldan bu la sbyin pa yis: bogs 'byin brtan pa rab thob nas: lus snang bde chen lha ru 363)dag: rtsa rlung thig le 'od du smin: rig pa chos nyid gzhi ru rdzogs: mi slob gzung 'jug lam mthar phyin: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog: rtsa sngags: ma hā mu dra dzñā na su kha siddhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas man shel me long thogs la: hūm̐: bsam brjod spros dang bral ba yi: rang byung rig pa ka nas dag: gsal la 'dzin med gnyug ma yi: brda don dpe yis dbang bskur ro: dri med rig stong ye shes nyid: logs na med do rang rig che: sku dang lam 'bras yon tan rdzogs: gcig car ma bcos ngang der zhog: gnyug sems ye shes chen po'i zhal: mngon gyur don gnyis e ma ho: rtsa sngags: ma hā tsitta dharma dha tu a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas srog dbang zab mo zhu ba la maṇḍal phul bas gsol gdab ni: kyai: gsang chen mnga' bdag bla ma rje: bdag cag skal ldan bu mchog la: bka' srung dregs pa rnam gsum gyi: srog dbang yongs rdzogs bka' drin stsol: lan gsum dang: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams kun: khyed cag ngas bsgos bka' bzhin du: brten sgrub brtson pa'i don nges na: 364)dregs pa rnam gsum srog gi dbang: slob dpon bdag gis khyod la sbyin: srog dang dam tshig gcig tu bsre: badzra sa ma ya: de nas ma mo'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: chos dbyings ngang las gzugs kyi sku: gsang sngags bka' yi gnyer 'dzin pa: kun bzang e ka ral gcig mas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: lus dag grib bzhin 'grogs pa dang: phrin las thogs med dbang thob shog: bhyo ma ma rakṣa e ka tsa ti sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

de nas drang srong chen po'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: sor rtogs rang gzugs khros pa'i gar: dam nyams srog gi gshaid po che: drang srong chen pos dbang bskur ro: lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs pa dang: drag po mthu yi dbang thob shog: oṃ hrīḥrakṣa ra hu la sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas dam can gy-i sku thogs la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: rgyal kun thugs rje'i rang gzugs gar: gnam sa gtsang chab phyed kyi bdag: skyes bu chen pos dbang bskur ro: dam can srog la dbang thob nas: phrin las rab 'byams yongs 'grub shog: tri shu la badzra sa dhu sa ma ya dzaḥsarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de bas srung ma'i rten gtor 365)thogs la: hūm̐: rang byung bhandha'i snod nang du: ba liṃ brjid ldan 'bar ba 'di: dregs pa rnam gsum sgrub pa'i rten: skal ldan bu la gtad pa yis: brten sgrub mchod la brtson pa yiḥ dregs pa'i srog la dbang thob nas: phrin las rab 'byams lhun grub shog: ma bhyo dza hriṃ rakṣa rā hu la tri badzra sā dhu ma hā ba liṃ ta sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gtor ma slob bu'i lag tu gtad la: dam tshig bsre ba ni: hūm̐: bu khyod da res skal bzang mchis: gsang sngags dkyil 'khor gnyen por zhugs: lha srung dam tshig gcig tu bsres: da ni dregs pa'i gtor ma la: brten nas byang chub ma thob bar: rgyun du bka' srung 'di nyid sgrubs: dam mi mthun la srung ma 'di'i: ming tsam brjod par mi bya'o: khyod la gtad do khyod kyis bsten: dam tshig ma 'da' sa ma ya: ces brjod dam tshig bsre: de nas phur bu thogs la: hūm̐: rgyal kun phrin las gcig bsdus he ru ka: ye shes mtshon cha'i rnam par rang shar ba: sras mchog kī la ya yis dbang bskur ro: bsgral 'dren nus stobs mchog gi dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

de nas brub khuung 366)ling ga thogs la: hūm̐: srid pa e zhal 'bar ba'i klong: gzung 'dzin ru tra ma ru tra'i: lus phung bsdams bcums gcun bcings g.yo med gnas: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la gtad pa yis: ma grol kun bsgral don la rab brtson nas: phrin las 'gro don mtha' rgyas dbang thob shog: badzra kī li kī la ya ma traṃ ru tra sarba mā ra ya phaṭa: ces brjod slob dpon gyis bsgral tshul mdzad nas slob bu la gtad: de nas sreg rdzas dang ling ro bsags la me hom thogs te: hūm̐: agna rā dza stobs po che: rang byung 'bar ba ye shes me: byin za 'bar ba lha'i gzhal yas: nyon mongs rang gzugs 'du phung rnams: sreg byed zhal hom khyod la gtad: mnan sreg las la dbang 'byor nas: phrin las 'gro don mthar phyin shog: agne de wa dzā la raṃ sarba pū dza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas 'byung lnga'i zor gtad la: hūm̐: 'byung lnga rnam dag yab yum lnga: rang rtsal phrin las thun mtshon sprul: skal ldan bu la gtad pa yis: nyon mongs brlag bsgral dbang thob shog: zor ya zor ya sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag spros bral 367)gzhong pa ru: lhun grub rang byung gtor ma bshams: ye shes 'od gsal gtor rgyan spras: rtsa gsum lha tshogs sgrub pa'i rten: skal ldan bu la gtad pa yis: yongs rdzogs gtor ma'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: ba liṃ ta sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bka' dbang ni: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la: hoḥ kun bzang yab yum: rdo rje 'chang chen: rdo rje sems dpa': dga' rab rdo rje: padma 'byung gnas: ye shes mtsho rgyal: rgyal ba mchog dbyangs: ka la siddhi: zhi ba mtsho: bde ba'i rdo rje: shī la badzra la sogs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa thams cad kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams smin par mdzad du gsol: grol bar mdzad du gsol: gang bar mdzad du gsol: yongs su grol bar mdzad du gsol:

rtsa sngags: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ ces brjod me tog 'thor nas dam tshig 'bogs: gtang rag longs spyod la sogs maṇḍal phul: rnam grangs khas blangs gsang chen don la gnas: dngos grub rnam gnyis 'thob pa'i skal bar ldan: dge bsngos bkra shis brjod cing me tog 'thor: las rjes mi mngon snod min rnams la gsang: de yis 368)don gnyis nor bu lon par nges: sa ma ya: e ma:shin tu gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba: yi dam kun 'dus snying po bla na med: dbang chen yab yum sgrub thabs zab mo 'di: snying mig srog las phangs pa'i gdams pa 'di: pad 'byung bdag gis mtsho rgyal khyed la gdams: da dung ma spel rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga la nye ba'i dus: mi srin lcags khams 'dul ba'i dus babs tshe: khyod sprul su kha badzra chu 'brug lo: nga min nga yi thugs sprul dang phrad nas: chos 'di'i dpal spyod bstan 'gro'i rgud pa sel: chos kyi bdag po mchog lnga ya brgyad dang: phran brgya dus dang dus su 'phrad par nges: log lam sapta'i dbang gis ma bsgyur na: chos 'di'i bstan pas yul gru la brgal nas: mtha' dmag kla klo'i 'phel kha brgyad cur bzlog: bka' 'di dregs pa rnam gsum thub par srungs: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: skal med log lta'i 'gro la a thaṃ rgya: rtog ge tha snyad mkhan gyi dbang po bsnubs: dam ldan chos kyi bu la legs par sprod: gang 'brel padma 'od du skye bor nges: nga yi bka' la bslu ba nam yang med: rang don gter sgrub gter spel gnad la rem: gzhan don ngal ba don med las phran spongs: bdag gi zab chos 'dzin skyong bri spel sogs: drug ldan mi 'da' ji bzhin gdul bya skal ldan rang dang 'tshams pa'i lam gnad so sor bstan pas sbyin pa/ bslab pa gsum ldan cing 369)rdo rje theg pa'i ring lugs la dbang 'byor pas theg brgyad grub mtha' so so ma 'dres par nyams 'og tu tshud pa'am klong du gyur pas na tshul khrims/

snyigs ma'i sems can gyi log sgrub bzod pas bzod pa/ zab gter bri spel gtan phabs sogs la skyo ngal med pas brtson 'grus/ chos nyid kyi don las mi 'da' zhing 'gro ba'i khams dbang dang mthun pa'i brda chos rol par shar bas bsam gtan/ lugs gnyis kyi shes bya la ma rmongs shing sgom byung gi ye shes la dbang bas shes rab/ de ltar gdul bya rjes su 'jin skabs gnad gal po che'o/ mchan/ bgyis gyur na: phyi ma gang 'brel mi gnas gtan srid zin: ye shes mtsho rgyal khyod kyis yi ger thob: ma 'ongs las can bu dang 'phrad par smon: sa ma yaḥ sku rgya: gsung rgya: gsang rgya: zab rgya: gu hya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang dus ring mo nas skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa gsar grogs yid bzhin nor bus rin chen sna tshogs dang ngo mtshar ba'i rdzas/ lha reg ind+ra'i mdangs 'dzin bcas bka' phebs spyi bor son pa dang*/ lung zin chos kyi bdag po ratna pā shaṃ mam gu hya'i mtshan 'chang ba po dang*/ nye char lung zin yi ge'i 'du byed dge btsun shī la badzra gnyis kyi bzhed don du rten 'brel btsan thabs su sad pas rkyen byas te/ dus mtha'i gter gzugs 'dzin pa'i snyoms las mdo med 'chol 370)mo kun bzang chos nyid bde skyong dbang mos mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda shog ser ma yig las zhal bshus pa'o// dge'o/ ha ha sprang mo'i rdzun tshig /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud// ma las bu la spel yod// ma lus bri spel mdzod dang*// ma gyur 'gro ba'i don chen// ma 'bad ngang gis 'byung nges// ma 'ongs padma 'od du// ma dang mkha' 'gros bsus nas// mi gnas gtan srid zin lags// sprang mo'i lag rtsed lags so// rta mgrin dbang gi skabs su/ da lan gyi skabs su bab pa lus med mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud kyi chos skor smrar shod gnas mchog bkra shis sgo mang nas spyan drangs pa'i zab gter yi dam dbang chen yab yum gyi rtsa dbang byin rlabs gter mdzod kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la=
sogs dbang gi lhan thabs ltar ro//
